_about: The third-wave publish. The base is the live second-wave site: a mirror of public_html as live (the second-wave tree, byte-identical to the site on 2026-10-24) and the site itself for anything the mirror lacks. Self-contained: the zip carries the report figures and every viewer the pages link, so it alone reproduces the India pages. Prepared, and inactive until their inputs exist: the angle-truss MSME shed (IN_Ex21) once its gold job folder holds a package, its title from titles_wave3.json, the page's example counts once it is published, and the nonlinear runs of the stage-2 re-run folder (a run is taken once its complete_gate.json is written; the MSME shed's run once it exists). Before building: the re-run golds in GOLD (new PEB golds, IN_Ex7-Ex20 re-sized, IN_Ex21), and NL_STAGE2 set to the folder the nonlinear re-runs are copied to (one folder per run id, at its id path).
